vars.name: ChangeMe
vars.#password: changeme — device-wide admin password, sent as the raw command `password <value>` (not `set password <value>`). Unlike other fields it can never be read back (no `get password` handler), so it's always (re-)applied when enabled, never diffed against a current value.
vars.#_comment3: af is the same underlying value as dutycycle above (dutycycle = 100/(af+1)) in a different unit — setting dutycycle already covers it
vars.#prv.key: REDACTED - identity key; a base template shouldn't clone one device's identity onto many, remove the # only when deliberately cloning a single specific device
vars.#public.key: REDACTED - informational only, no set handler exists for this field in the firmware
